title: Creamy Zesty Pasta
description: A simple and flavorful pasta dish with a zesty twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the zesty sauce over medium heat.
Add the softened creamy cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Drain the cooked pasta and add to the skillet with the cheese sauce.
Toss the pasta in the cheese sauce until well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
